audit.why: Both layers already read Graves / Skill / Ambessa / Ambessa / Ambessa / Ambessa / Graves, which is exactly the chart the mirrored Ambessa-vs-Graves audit settled on. The packet chart differs at rows 3, 4 and 7, but the mirror is the binding side and the two must not disagree.
audit.corrected: No change. Level 1 Graves, Level 2 Skill, Levels 3 through first item Ambessa, 2+ items Graves.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 stage was written with a generic Collateral Damage line and no numbers, and a 'fifteen-second invitation' that matches nothing in either kit.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130/115/100s with 1250 range; Repudiation is 18/17/16/15/14s. Those are the two clocks the lane runs on.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is Public Execution (R, 130s at rank 1): a 1250-unit blink into a suppression and a stun. The repeatable window is Repudiation at 18s, not fifteen.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent and one was wrong. Repudiation (W) grounds — it shuts off Quickdraw entirely — and that is never stated. Her CC was described as 'slow into root'; there is no root in her kit. Smoke Screen was called a blind in five places.
audit.why: Riot's text: Repudiation grounds and shields while bracing; Public Execution blinks, suppresses, then stuns; Lacerate slows. Graves' W reduces sight range and briefly slows on impact — it does not make attacks miss, so it was never an answer to her ability damage.
audit.corrected: Repudiation (W, 18s at rank 1) grounds you, so Quickdraw cannot take you out of her combo — that, not the damage, is why her all-in connects. Public Execution suppresses on arrival and stuns on the slam. Smoke Screen nearsights and slows; it does nothing to spell damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ambessa's passive was called 'Dash Chain' throughout the page — focus text, loading screen, cooldown block, six report and do/don't lines.
audit.why: Her passive is Drakehound's Step: entering a move or attack command during a cast makes her dash and empowers the next attack. 'Dash Chain' does not exist. The packet defect list already flagged that the page never names a single real Ambessa ability.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real names — Repudiation for the cooldown the player tracks, Public Execution for the ultimate threat.

edits.before: Level 1 is yours for once — she only has one ability and no dash to bail, so when she walks up to last-hit, auto-Q her and your point-blank shell spread out-damages her flat. Take that trade and set the tone. From level 2-3 it gets honest: her dashes let her weave into your short shell range and slide back out before your End of the Line cone detonates, so don't panic-throw Q at empty ground — hold it for when a dash commits her. Use Quickdraw to reposition into point-blank range where your spread actually hurts, and save W to blind a key autoattack if she steps on you.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours for once — she only has one ability and no dash to bail, so when she walks up to last-hit, auto-Q her and your point-blank shell spread out-damages her flat. Take that trade and set the tone. From level 2-3 it gets honest: Drakehound's Step lets her weave into your short shell range and slide back out before your End of the Line cone detonates, so don't panic-throw Q at empty ground — hold it for when a dash commits her. Use Quickdraw to reposition point-blank where your spread hurts, and save Smoke Screen for the disengage, never as a shield.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your best honest edge before her ult: your True Grit armor from staying in combat and your second Quickdraw charge compound, so a clean point-blank Q-plus-auto burst with a dash to stay glued out-trades her here. Force those all-ins while she's still ult-less. But the moment she hits 6 the lane flips — her chain CC pins you in place and her ult plus combo damage bursts you, and crucially your W blind does NOTHING to her ability damage, so smoke only buys a disengage and broken vision, not survival. Once she's 6, don't sit in dash range with your magazine empty.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your best honest edge before her ult: True Grit stacks while you stay in combat, so a clean point-blank Q-plus-auto burst with a dash to stay glued out-trades her here. Force those all-ins while she's still ult-less. But the moment she hits 6 the lane flips — Public Execution suppresses and stuns, Repudiation grounds Quickdraw so you cannot leave, and crucially Smoke Screen does NOTHING to her ability damage: it cuts her sight and slows, nothing more. Once she's 6, don't sit in dash range with your magazine empty.
